Inside lay a brittle page, its ink faded to the color of weak tea. The writer was a girl who had sailed past in a storm years ago, thanking whoever kept the lamp burning, for its beam had guided her father home. She signed it simply, with a child's careful letters. Alden sat on the cold step and read it three times. He had often wondered whether the light mattered to anyone beyond the ships he never met. Now he knew. That night he climbed the stairs smiling, and lit the lamp earlier than usual.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一张尚未醒来的脸。街灯还亮着，光晕里浮着薄薄的雾气。空荡的马路上，偶尔驶过一辆出租车，轮胎碾过湿漉漉的地面，发出细碎的声响。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸笼冒出第一缕白气，面点师傅在昏黄灯下揉面。环卫工人推着车，扫帚划过落叶。远处高楼还沉在黑暗里，只有零星几扇窗透出微光。天边泛起一线灰蓝，新的一天正悄悄逼近。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It keeps shrinking the problem until it reaches a tiny one that is super easy to answer right away.\n- Like standing between two mirrors: each reflection is a smaller copy of the same thing, repeating again and again."}
